entities.summary: The Inspectorate-General of Army Aviation or Inspectorate General of Aviation  was a section of the Imperial Japanese Army Aeronautical Department charged with planning and supervision of the training of flying and air maintenance personnel of the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service.
